nodes.label: UCPOF: Uncertainty-Calibrated Prompt Optimization Framework
nodes.author: Wei Chen, Guoyang Ju, Yuanyuan Qi
nodes.rationale: Framework for LLM classification that uses first-token uncertainty to optimize prompts and adaptively trigger RAG; improves accuracy by 6.03% while reducing retrieval cost by 50.66%.

nodes.label: Log-Scale Focal Uncertainty (LSFU)
nodes.rationale: First-token-based uncertainty metric inspired by focal loss that incorporates label prior probabilities to suppress spurious confidence from high-frequency classes and emphasize risk for long-tail classes.

nodes.label: First-Token Confidence Hypothesis
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis that concentration of first-token predictive distribution serves as early proxy for model's overall predictive confidence; uncertainty at initial stage amplifies during subsequent generation.

nodes.label: Gold Shot Selection (Static Prompt Optimization)
nodes.rationale: LSFU-driven strategy to select N samples with lowest LSFU values as few-shot exemplars; provides clear decision anchors and minimizes cognitive noise in prompts.

nodes.label: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
nodes.rationale: Technique that enriches prompts with external knowledge to mitigate hallucinations; UCPOF uses LSFU to trigger RAG adaptively only for high-uncertainty samples.

nodes.label: Focal Loss
nodes.rationale: Loss function that addresses class imbalance by down-weighting easy examples; LSFU adapts focal loss principles to uncertainty measurement for prompt optimization.

nodes.label: In-Context Learning (ICL)
nodes.rationale: Paradigm where LLMs adapt to downstream tasks without parameter updates using only prompts; UCPOF optimizes ICL through uncertainty-calibrated exemplar selection and dynamic correction.

nodes.label: Shannon Entropy (Uncertainty Measure)
nodes.rationale: Traditional uncertainty measure that LSFU improves upon by incorporating label priors; computed over top-K first-token candidates for efficiency.

nodes.label: Selective Prediction
nodes.rationale: Framework where system can abstain from prediction on uncertain samples; UCPOF implements selective prediction by triggering RAG for high-uncertainty samples.
